facts.text: Outpatient doctor visits are reimbursed at 80% up to EUR 60 per visit, max 12 visits per policy year.
Planned hospital admissions need prior approval from the insurer at least 3 working days before admission. Emergencies are exempt but must be reported within 48 hours.
Routine dental care is not covered. Accident-related dental treatment is covered up to EUR 500 per year.
Claims must be submitted within 90 days of the treatment date with the original invoice and payment receipt.
Spouses and children up to age 26 can be added at the group rate during enrolment or within 30 days of a qualifying life event.

emergency.text: In an emergency call local emergency services (112) first, then the 24/7 assistance line.
